modes.note: 1 Yep = 1 second of process execution, rounded up per execution. Overage on Starter: EUR 0.00001 per extra Yep = $0.04096/h at fx 1.1378 USD/EUR (research/fx.json, ECB 2026-09-28). Priced per running process, whatever CPU it uses.

plans.name: Developer
plans.note: Free: 50K Yeps, max 300 executions/day, 1 concurrent, 30 s max execution, limited CPU/memory; no paid overage (runs stop when Yeps run out). Cannot run real workloads: trial_only.

plans.name: Starter
plans.note: EUR 119/month = $135.40 at 1.1378 USD/EUR. Includes 15M Yeps (4,166.7 process-hours, = included_usd at the overage rate); then +EUR 0.00001 per extra Yep. Max 10 concurrent, 1 h max execution, 300 MB RAM sandboxes, up to 10 team members.

plans.name: Growth
plans.note: EUR 599/month = $681.54 at 1.1378 USD/EUR. Includes 150M Yeps (41,666.7 process-hours); then +EUR 0.000005 per extra Yep. Max 50 concurrent, 12 h max execution, 600 MB RAM sandboxes, unlimited team members.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Starting at EUR 1,800/month (~$2,048 at 1.1378 USD/EUR); custom limits; negotiated.

caveats: Prices are published in EUR only and converted at 1.1378 USD/EUR (ECB reference 2026-09-28, research/fx.json); the USD invoice amount depends on your card FX. Each plan has its own overage rate, so each regime is tied to one plan. vCPU per process is not published (sizes unsized).
Public list prices rendered in EUR; Yeps are rounded-up seconds of process execution. General JS/Python execution service; self-serve memory only300MB/600MB, not arbitrary8GiB machines.

Features set to null were not verified. No sandbox was purchased or tested; feature/performance statements are documentation claims. Null maximums are unknown unless a cited note explicitly states unlimited.
A complete monthly bill requires known snapshot/egress/plan limits; do not silently treat missing ancillary charges as free.

fleet.verification: Developer free plan requires no credit card.
fleet.tiers: Higher paid plans provide more concurrency; custom enterprise arrangements available.
fleet.notes: Developer: 1 concurrent execution, 300 executions/day, 30 seconds/execution. Queue time is not running concurrency. Paid plan limits and execution credits both matter; no approval SLA specified.
